remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated, move-in ready two-story home in Brea! Offering approximately 2,104 square feet of living space, this spacious home features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and an attached two-car garage. Thoughtfully upgraded by the current owners, the home showcases beautiful flooring throughout, remodeled bathrooms, and fresh interior paint throughout, creating a bright, modern, and inviting atmosphere. The spacious floor plan features soaring ceilings, a welcoming living room, formal dining area, and a comfortable family room with a cozy fireplace. The previously updated kitchen opens to a casual dining area, offering a functional layout for everyday living and entertaining
